G1_unambiguity.justification: The definitions of the energy, interference indicators, critically flawed triplets, and lexicographic output rule give a single clear interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: It specifies the input bounds and format, graph constraints, existence guarantee, coefficient domain, validity condition, ordering, and tie-breaking rule.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The quadratic condition holds for a nonzero coefficient vector exactly when all three links are present, so the valid and lexicographically selected triples are the same as in the original.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and idiomatic, although the elaborate interference-energy setup feels somewhat artificial for the underlying triangle-finding task.
